contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Author and select realization profiles. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.
Enable an owner or builder to express checked technical profile choices for supported architecture, target-language and runtime realizations while keeping business meaning separately owned.
acceptance_conditions: Technical selections remain distinct from authored business rules and permissions.
Profile inputs, selected package identities and capability/compatibility constraints are explicit.
Technical defaults do not silently override business constraints or grant access.
Only supported finite realization shapes are advertised.
exclusions: Arbitrary architecture generators, custom ABIs or every target language
Performance measurements, automatic business-meaning revision or authority from profile selection

contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Compose compatible profiles and inspect constraints. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.
Enable a builder to combine supported source-selected profile packages and child consumers while inspecting compatibility, capability coverage and provenance before generation.
acceptance_conditions: Every selected child/package and required capability is explicit.
Composition preserves source/parent/child identities and graph/bridge provenance.
Unsupported or conflicting compositions reject without silent fallback.
Local fixture/profile evidence does not qualify arbitrary future compositions.
exclusions: Universal profile interoperability or automatic provider failover
Treating candidate transport-profile design as a qualified runtime

contracts.meaning: Explicit supported source/project/profile/resource selection for Bind profiles to exact native and provider realizations. Supported dialects and limits stay those of the selected current components.

Enable a builder to connect supported checked source/profile selections to exact existing business, native, provider-stage and runtime owners while preserving ABI, command identity and resource/permission boundaries.
acceptance_conditions: Selections identify original package/export/factory/ABI and original operation/effect owners.
Registered resources supply trusted frames without minting authorization or custody.
Command identities and original business decisions survive generated installation.
Unknown effects and unsupported joins are not retried through implicit alternate providers.
exclusions: Arbitrary native exports/ABIs, provider APIs or new integration profiles from a descriptor alone
Real-account/model quality, host enrollment or deployment qualification from fixtures
